{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to src/interfaces/wallet.h and src/wallet/interfaces.cpp only add methods for wallet and GUI integration rather than modifying IPC infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Non-member. Category excludes wallet interface additions where interface mechanics are not the point."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/rpc/output_script.cpp and src/rpc/rawtransaction_util.cpp, introducing the new diagnostic RPC scantxforsilentpayments and raw transaction support for silent payment destinations.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds the diagnostic RPC scantxforsilentpayments and raw transaction destination handling for BIP 352. While useful for inspecting and creating raw silent payment transactions, new RPC methods without explicit external consumer demand are lower priority than the wallet feature itself."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "The PR adds area-specific functional tests (wallet_silentpayments_sending.py) and unit tests rather than test framework or harness infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Non-member. Tests pinning wallet sending and coin selection behavior belong to the wallet area."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/common/paymentdestination.* and src/common/bip352.* introduce domain-specific destination types and protocol logic for silent payments rather than node-wide utilities.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Non-member. PaymentDestination is a domain abstraction tailored to transaction construction rather than general shared utility infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Major modifications across src/wallet/spend.cpp, src/wallet/feebumper.cpp, src/wallet/coinselection.h, and wallet persistence to enable sending to BIP 352 addresses.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Enables sending to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses, solving a user privacy pain point by preventing address reuse for recipients. While it provides substantial strategic value for Bitcoin Core's privacy capabilities (part of #28536), it delivers a new feature rather than fixing an urgent fund-safety or security regression."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,

    "leverage": 1
  }
}
